verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official CLI (ldcli) for macOS, Windows, and Linux that manages feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources from the command line, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: set up and manage your feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources directly from the command line.
The LaunchDarkly CLI is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
